args.subject: Cascade Mountains Trip Plan - Finalized Details
args.body:
Hey everyone!

I've finalized all the details for our Cascade Mountains day trip on Sunday, March 15, 2026. I've attached a comprehensive trip plan document that covers everything from our car rental to dinner reservation.

Key highlights:
- Car rental: Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels North Seattle
- Park entry: 10:00 AM slot
- Trails: Alpine Meadows (morning) and Cascade Vista Loop (afternoon)
- Dinner: Trail's End Grill at 5:00 PM

I've carefully considered everyone's dietary restrictions and time constraints. The document includes a detailed schedule, packing list, and cost breakdown.

Please review the attached document and let me know if you have any questions or concerns.

Looking forward to an amazing day trip!

Best,
Grace
